brand.name: Fashion Nails & Spa
brand.tagline: Great looks. Good prices. Personal care.

hero.eyebrow: YOUR LITTLE BEAUTY ESCAPE IN LEWISTOWN, PA
hero.title: A little polish.
hero.description: A fresh set, a favorite color, a moment just for you. Make yourself at home at Fashion Nails & Spa.

about.heading: Your neighborhood salon. Your kind of beautiful.
about.description: Find us on Water Street in the heart of Lewistown. From a simple polish to a little extra sparkle, we’re here to help you find a look that feels like you. Come on your own, bring a friend, or make it a little celebration.

gifts.heading: Give a little me-time.
gifts.description: For birthdays, holidays, thank-yous, or just because. Ask us about gift certificates and let someone special choose their own moment of self-care.

services.name: Manicure
services.description: A fresh shape, a favorite shade, and a beautifully polished finish.
services.details: A fresh manicure can be an everyday finishing touch or the start of a special occasion. Tell us whether you prefer a short, practical shape, a soft neutral, or a brighter color. We’ll talk through the service and finish that suit your current nails and the options available at the salon.
services.highlights:
Your preferred nail length and shape
The color and polish finish you have in mind
Any existing product that may need removal
A personal quote before your appointment is confirmed
services.preparation:
Bring a photo or save a color reference if you have one.
Let us know if you already have gel, extensions, or another product on your nails.
Mention any product sensitivities or comfort concerns when you call.
services.goodToKnow: The exact steps, polish options, price, and appointment length are confirmed by the salon. Removal, repairs, or extra design work may need a separate quote. The photos show examples from our collection, rather than a fixed package.

services.name: Gel Nails
services.description: Glossy color for your everyday style. Ask us about available finishes.
services.details: Love a glossy finish? Ask us about our current gel nail options, available colors, and the look you would like to create. A gel appointment should be planned around what is already on your nails, your preferred length and shape, and any design details you want to add.
services.highlights:
Available gel colors and finishes
Your preferred shape and length
Whether existing gel or another product needs removal
Any nail art or extra details you want included in the quote
services.preparation:
Tell us what product is currently on your nails, if you know.
Avoid picking or peeling off existing gel before your visit; ask about appropriate removal.
Bring a reference image and let us know if you need a repair.
services.goodToKnow: Products, application options, removal, and appointment lengths vary. Please confirm what is included and how to care for your finish with the salon. No specific wear time or result is guaranteed by the website.

services.name: Nail Art & Designs
services.description: A little personality at your fingertips, from playful details to extra sparkle.
services.details: From a small accent to a look with a little more sparkle, nail art starts with your inspiration. Bring a photo, a color palette, or a simple idea. We’ll discuss which details can work with your nails and the services currently available, then confirm the quote and time needed.
services.highlights:
Your color palette and inspiration photos
Simple accents, pattern details, or sparkle you would like to discuss
The shape and length needed for the look
A quote based on the amount of detail and work involved
services.preparation:
Save one or two clear photos of your favorite designs.
Tell us whether the color, shape, or artwork matters most to you.
Mention any existing product, removal, or repair work when arranging your visit.
services.goodToKnow: Designs are quoted individually. Photo inspiration is a starting point, and the final look depends on your nails, the materials available, and the details agreed with your technician. Please confirm added design time before booking.

services.name: Pedicure
services.description: Take a seat and give your feet a little attention and a fresh pop of color.
services.details: Take a seat and give your toes a fresh start. Whether you have a favorite everyday shade or want a color for a special occasion, call us to discuss the pedicure options currently available and the finish you have in mind.
services.highlights:
Current pedicure services and what each option includes
Your preferred polish color and finish
Any existing product that needs removal
The service price and time needed before you arrive
services.preparation:
Mention existing polish, gel, or other product when you call.
Ask what footwear is best for your chosen finish after the visit.
Let the salon know about comfort or product concerns in advance.
services.goodToKnow: The photos are examples from our salon collection. Treatment steps, polish options, add-ons, and appointment lengths are confirmed by phone; the website does not promise a particular package or result.

services.name: Waxing
services.description: A finishing touch to your beauty routine. Call to discuss areas and availability.
services.details: For a finishing touch to your beauty routine, speak with the salon about the waxing services and treatment areas currently available. Tell us which area you want to discuss so we can advise on the options, preparation, time, and pricing before you visit.
services.highlights:
Which treatment areas are currently available
Your preparation and aftercare questions
Product sensitivities or skin-care concerns to discuss with the team
The exact service, price, and appointment length
services.preparation:
Call to confirm that your requested treatment area is available.
Ask the salon for preparation instructions for the specific service.
Mention recent skin treatments, product sensitivities, or other concerns before confirming your visit.
services.goodToKnow: Available treatments, preparation, and pricing depend on the area and service discussed with the salon. Confirm those details and any aftercare guidance before your visit. The photos on this page show the salon interior.

services.name: Facial Care
services.description: Make a little room for self-care. Call us to find out about current facial services.
services.details: Make a little room for self-care. Call to ask about the facial care options currently offered, tell us what you would like from the visit, and discuss products or comfort preferences before choosing a service.
services.highlights:
Current facial care services and what is included
Your goals and preferred level of care
Products and sensitivities you would like to discuss
Preparation, appointment length, and a confirmed quote
services.preparation:
Call ahead to discuss the service you have in mind.
Mention product sensitivities and any recent skin treatments.
Ask for preparation and aftercare guidance for the specific service offered.
services.goodToKnow: Ask which facial services and products are currently available and what each option includes. Your service, preparation, price, and appointment length are confirmed directly with the salon. The photos show the salon interior.
